note: Published G3P success counts for the six problems of this suite: runs out of 100 whose best program solves every test case. The rows were transcribed from the paper and thesis tables and checked against them on 2026-11-10. Other systems' rows (PushGP) are not listed because the report does not use them. These runs used PTC2 initialization, a 250-node derivation-tree limit and a 1 s execution limit, with the grammars of this suite ported in README.md, so the counts are context and not a matched baseline.
